headline: I Love All Things Marketing!
company_description:
Sabichi Homewares was established in 1994 with one mission—to bring quality homewares to UK consumers at a great price. The company supplies housewares products to major UK retailers, independent businesses, and international clients. Sabichi designs, develops, produces, imports, and exports products under the Sabichi brand as well as customers' private label brands. With a well-developed sourcing infrastructure based in the UK and Hong Kong, retail partners can rely on Sabichi's expertise to develop and deliver design-led lifestyle products at affordable prices. Sabichi's 120,000-square-foot distribution centre in Worksop enables next-day delivery across the UK. Sabichi Homewares prides itself on providing high-quality service and being a trustworthy, honest family business.

In 2016, Sabichi acquired the iconic British small electricals brand Haden from Russell Hobbs. Sabichi introduced new Haden product ranges, including small domestic appliances, cookware, kitchen accessories, and major domestic appliances. Returning to its roots, Sabichi is focusing on Haden's heritage of pioneering colour and design in kitchen appliances.In 2016, Sabichi acquired an iconic British small electricals brand Haden from Russell Hobbs. HairFlair celebrate curls and waves of all shapes, types, sizes, ages or demographics.
We're an international mix of women who believe that being able to celebrate your natural style is important; this is why we're on a mission to develop products that not only make you look and feel great but highlight your natural beauty, bringing different cultures and representations of what beauty means, to life; in a unique and individual way; in order to help you be kinder to your hair with zero compromises to your style.

Our products have been designed with world-class technology allowing the straightest of hair to the frizziest curls benefit from our products; allowing you to achieve amazing results with ZERO damage to your hair.

We are proud to acknowledge that over 2 million people are already using our products.

An in the professional sector we some of the greatest experts already using our products to create the modern-day perm. And if that isn't enough, we have our newly launched Waveformers® aimed at creating long-lasting, softer waves.

Today, both Curlformers® and Waveformers® are known to be the only patented, heat-free, salon-quality hair curler in the world that comes with a lifetime guarantee.
